defuss-shadcn / Website / Industries / industry-hotel

Hotel

A one-page site for a small hotel in an old net loft on a Baltic harbour quay - an availability search that prices every room for your nights with the city tax, rooms with their size in square metres and a photo viewer, the restaurant and bar, packages, the way there, reviews and the check-in times. Three looks: Harbour, Linen and Night. One of the Showcase sites.

Open full screen

Hotel Ebbstein, Möwensund

Change the dates or the guests: every room card says whether it fits and what the nights cost - the rate times the nights plus the city tax of €2.80 per adult and night. A room's photo or Photos & details opens its dialog with a photo viewer; Request carries the dates into the booking request, which sends to a thank-you. The water under the search is a Shader; the key tag, the note from the cutter and the 3 for 2 stamp carry the check-in times, the catch and the offer. The Look select switches between Harbour, Linen and Night.

×%

Built from Site Header (its Sheet menu on a phone), Hero (split), Section Header, Card with Badge, Date Picker, Select, Location Map, Testimonials with Rating and Avatar, FAQ (accordion), Site Footer and Dialogs with Input, Checkbox and Textarea; the rooms' photos scroll in the Media Gallery's track. The water is a Shader (water) whose colours are the look's tokens. The prices are computed in the page's script; the palettes are tokens on the site's root, so every component inside follows the look.
